title: Barney Josephson fires him over a note from a starlet
summary: A movie actress's unpaid tab and a note led Josephson to fire Turner until Hammond got him rehired.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Oh, I don't remember all them people's names. Ahhhhh, I can't think of them people's names but anyway, was a gang of 'em. Ohhhh, gee...saw one of 'em on the tv the other night. Anyway, we had a good time. Anyway then, when we got through, we got down to the nightclub, some chicks from Hollywood--they had run up a big bill...two-three thousand dollar bill there in the club, so they didn't...they didn't have the money to pay. It was two chicks...they used to play in the movies. So one of them sent me a note one night, wanted me to go out with 'em. So we went back to the fellow's after-hours joint, so we had a ball. So...in fact, we went back two...three times, so when they got ready to leave, they didn't have no money. They done run up all this tab...been eatin' 'n' dinin' 'n' winin' an' goin' on so they told Barney Josephson that I insulted...insulted 'em, so Barney Josephson didn't take my word for it. He...uh...got after me about it...'cause he was tryin' to make the chick heself but he didn't have no luck. I went out with her. So, once she told him that, he fired me. So, I still had the note she sent me in my pocket so that...that the manager there--me an' he was tight. So's he used to bring me all kinds of notes from different chicks

in the nightclub, y'know.
"Heyyyy, ya got another chick, Joe. Here's a note."
So he tried to tell Barney Josephson that it wasn't thataway.
He said, "Joe Turner ain't done nothin' like that."
So, Barney Josephson...she done soaped him all up, you know,
and he was still tryin' to git...still tryin' to git an' make it with her,
so he says, "Well, I'm gonna fire him."
So I didn't talk to him for about three days. And John Hammond
...I told John Hammonds about it. John Hammond said, "Don't worry about
it." So John Hammond went down there and made him put me back to work.
